channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Dust Devil Tracks on Bright Dunes
item.description: This image features dark dust devil tracks on bright dunes that have an odd distribution. The dunes look wind eroded: striations or layering? A false color contrast between dunes and dust devil tracks may provide information to understand dune formation, shape, and dust devil initiation. This footprint is in Galle Crater. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
